name: Google Workspace Reports
description: Google Workspace admin and login activity: who did what, from where, in which application. One feed for the gws:reports:login, gws:reports:admin and gws:reports:drive sourcetypes and their Sentinel connector tables.
source: Google Workspace Admin SDK Reports API, activities resource and the per-application event appendices; TA-GoogleWorkspaceForSplunk field extraction; the Google Workspace Reports solution's GWorkspaceActivityReports.yaml parser

feed.label: Google Workspace Reports
feed.description: Google Workspace admin console and login activity from the Reports API: sign-ins, admin console changes and Drive sharing changes, one record per event.

event_time.label: Event time
event_time.description: When the activity happened (id.time on the Reports API; TimeGenerated is Sentinel's own ingestion column).

actor_email.label: Actor email
actor_email.description: The email address of the user or admin who performed the activity.

actor_profile_id.label: Actor profile id
actor_profile_id.description: A stable, opaque id for the actor's Workspace profile.

actor_caller_type.label: Actor caller type
actor_caller_type.description: Who or what made the call, for example USER; present on admin console activities.

source_ip.label: Source IP address
source_ip.description: The address the request came from.

application_name.label: Application name
application_name.description: Which Reports API application the activity belongs to, for example login or admin.

customer_id.label: Customer id
customer_id.description: The Workspace customer id the activity belongs to.

unique_qualifier.label: Unique qualifier
unique_qualifier.description: The activity's own id, unique together with the time and application name.

event_type.label: Event type
event_type.description: The category of activity within the application, for example login or USER_SETTINGS.

event_name.label: Event name
event_name.description: The specific event within its type, for example login_success or UNENROLL_USER_FROM_STRONG_AUTH.

event_parameters.label: Event parameters
event_parameters.description: The event's own name/value detail. On login and admin activities this is an array of {name, value|boolValue|multiValue}; the drive connector table flattens the same detail to top-level columns.

etag.label: Etag
etag.description: The activity record's own etag, as the Reports API returns it.

gws:reports:login.description: Google Workspace login activity (the Reports API's login application) as TA-GoogleWorkspaceForSplunk indexes it: one record per event, actor and id nested, event.parameters an array.

gws:reports:admin.description: Google Workspace admin console activity (the Reports API's admin application), same nested shape as login.

gws:reports:drive.description: Google Drive sharing activity, already flattened by this capture's source (http:gsuite): parameters is one object, not an array.
gws:reports:drive.note: The Reports API's own drive application uses the same nested id/actor/event shape as login and admin; this container is the flattened form the seeded capture actually carries.

GWorkspace_ReportsAPI_login_CL.description: The Google Workspace Reports solution's per-application ingest table for login activities.

GWorkspace_ReportsAPI_admin_CL.description: The Google Workspace Reports solution's per-application ingest table for admin console activities.

GWorkspace_ReportsAPI_drive_CL.description: The Google Workspace Reports solution's per-application ingest table for Drive activities; parameters land as top-level, type-suffixed columns (doc_id_s, owner_s, and so on).

ip_shared.text: A NAT gateway, VPN exit or shared proxy can put many people behind one address; a match is a lead, not a link.

names_not_stable.text: An actor is identified by email; a rename or an alias change moves the identifier, not the person.
